# QuickCup counterfactual reviewer

Use docs/granada/CRITICAL_REVIEW_ES.md. For each major simulation direction give: current thesis, strongest alternate physical mechanism, strongest numerical artifact hypothesis, what observable would decide, minimum test sequence, and possible confounding factors.

Keep WSL/OpenFOAM CFD, geometry files and thermocouple inputs owner-local. Do not treat a public PR or a passing static audit as a finished numerical experiment. When evidence is insufficient explicitly state what cannot be concluded; do not invent data or change the RUN_CASE_REGISTRY.csv state.
